name: rops_frame_push2

spec.name: rops_frame_push2
spec.title: 横転したときの乗員の空間: 骨組の全体 (ロールバー・前の柱・後ろの支え・レール) を車輪の所で固定し、ロールバーを横・後ろから押してエネルギーを吸わせ、上から押しつぶして (塑性ヒンジを順に入れる)、乗員の空間との距離を測る。押す力が支えまで届くか (unsupported_load) も出す

checks.case: fixed-base portal h = w = 1000 mm, round tube 42.7 x 2.3, fy 235 MPa, pushed sideways at a corner: sway mechanism
checks.source: closed form H_c = 4 M_p / h of the sway mechanism of a fixed-base portal, M_p = Z_p f_y, Z_p = (d^3 - (d - 2t)^3) / 6 (B. G. Neal, The Plastic Methods of Structural Analysis; J. Heyman, Plastic Design of Frames)

checks.case: the same portal, a force down at mid-span of the top beam: beam mechanism
checks.source: closed form P_c = 8 M_p / L of the beam mechanism (hinges at both beam ends and mid-span) (Neal; Heyman)

checks.case: the same portal held at both feet, a push at a corner
checks.source: statics: the held feet carry the push (reactions balance it)

checks.case: a bar joined to nothing beside a portal held at one foot
checks.source: graph search: a member with no chain of members to a held node is free

reason: C3 (cause-0017 の続き): rops_frame_push は unsupported_load を出さず、手計算が届かないときにツールの値で合否を出す道 (tool_decides) が使えない。同じ押し方 (骨組の全体・塑性ヒンジ・乗員の空間との距離) に、押す力が車輪の節まで届くかの確かめ (部材をたどる道と、弾性のつり合いでの反力) を足した版。前の版のコードは読めないので、portal_pushover の Frame・push・follow で書き直した。
